verdict.rationale: 1Password is a password and secrets manager, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. The evidence shows only the opposite role: 1Password publishes MCP servers (the Developer docs MCP and the Environments MCP Server) for other clients such as Claude Code and Cursor to connect to. That server-side evidence does not make this client-side story applicable, and nothing shows 1Password itself loading or using third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
